grammarRule.formula: I have a + [headache / sore throat] / My [body part] hurts.

explanation.ml: ശാരീരിക അസ്വസ്ഥതകൾ പറയുമ്പോൾ 'I have a headache' (എനിക്ക് തലവേദനയുണ്ട്) അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 'My ankle hurts' (എന്റെ കണങ്കാൽ വേദനിക്കുന്നു) എന്ന് ലളിതമായി പറയാം.
explanation.en: Master Health, Body & Minor Ailments with clear formula: I have a + [headache / sore throat] / My [body part] hurts.

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 'I have a headache / stomach ache / toothache / cold / cough / fever' എന്ന് പറയാം. എന്നാൽ 'hurt' ഉപയോഗിക്കുമ്പോൾ 'My knee hurts' (വേദനിക്കുന്നു) എന്ന് പറയുക.
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 'I have a headache / stomach ache / toothache / cold / cough / fever' എന്ന് പറയാം. എന്നാൽ 'hurt' ഉപയോഗിക്കുമ്പോൾ 'My knee hurts' (വേദനിക്കുന്നു) എന്ന് പറയുക.

verbs.example: He accidentally sprained his left ankle during the football match.
verbs.exampleMl: Wrench or twist the ligaments of an ankle, wrist, or other joint violently so as to cause pain.

nouns.definition: A continuous pain in the head.
nouns.example: I have had a mild headache since this morning.

nouns.definition: An abnormally high body temperature, usually accompanied by shivering and headache.
nouns.example: The child is running a slight fever and resting in bed.

nouns.definition: Wrench or twist the ligaments of an ankle, wrist, or other joint violently so as to cause pain.
nouns.example: He accidentally sprained his left ankle during the football match.

nouns.definition: Extreme tiredness resulting from mental or physical exertion or illness.
nouns.example: Lack of restful sleep leads to chronic mental fatigue.

nouns.definition: A sensation of spinning around and losing one's balance.
nouns.example: Drink some electrolyte water to prevent sudden dizziness.

nouns.definition: A strip of woven material used to bind up or protect a wound or injury.
nouns.example: The nurse wrapped a clean sterile bandage around the scraped knee.

sentences.text: After a rainy bicycle ride, Tarun felt a heavy chill throughout his body.

sentences.meaningHi: बारिश में साइकिल चलाने के बाद तरुण को पूरे शरीर में तेज़ ठंड लगी।
sentences.meaningTa: மழையில் சைக்கிள் ஓட்டிய பிறகு தருணுக்கு உடல் முழுவதும் நடுக்கம் ஏற்பட்டது.

sentences.meaningHi: शाम तक उसका माथा गर्म था और गले में खराश महसूस हो रही थी।
sentences.meaningTa: மாலைக்குள் அவன் நெற்றி சுட்டது மற்றும் தொண்டையில் வலி ஏற்பட்டது.

sentences.meaningHi: उन्होंने उसे एक मोटे ऊनी कंबल के नीचे सुला दिया ताकि पसीने से बुखार उतर सके।

traps.question: Select the correct expression for having a headache:
traps.explanation: 'I have a headache' is the natural, idiomatic English expression.
traps.ruleHint: Idiomatic Health: 'I have a headache / stomach ache / cold'.

traps.question: Choose the correct past tense sentence for an injured leg:
options: I was hurted my leg yesterday.
I did hurted my leg yesterday.
traps.explanation: The verb 'hurt' has identical past forms: hurt (V1) - hurt (V2) - hurt (V3). 'Hurted' does not exist.

traps.question: How do you ask about someone's stomach discomfort politely?
traps.explanation: 'Does your stomach hurt?' correctly uses the auxiliary 'does' with base verb 'hurt'.
traps.ruleHint: Auxiliary Rule: Does + singular subject (stomach) + hurt?
